notes: UK 2026/27 confirmed by SPFL/Sky: Sky Sports (up to 60 live Premiership games, all six opening-weekend games) and Premier Sports (20 pre-split + 2 post-split); BBC Scotland Sportscene highlights; no live Premiership games free-to-air in the UK. International: SPFL says matches are broadcast in 150+ countries via agency Infront (contract to summer 2029, new Japan/South Korea deals with unnamed broadcasters); no official 2026-27 country list was found, so international entries use Wikipedia's latest (undated) table and may be partly outdated. Gaps: Canada, Japan, South Korea, India, France, Spain, Belgium not covered by a source read.

broadcasters.note: Sky Sports: up to 60 live Premiership matches in 2026/27 (max five per ground), incl. all six opening-weekend games; deal 2024/25-2028/29. Premier Sports: 20 live pre-split matches plus 2 bottom-six post-split matches per season to 2028/29. BBC Scotland: Sportscene highlights (deal extended to summer 2029); its live Friday games are Championship, not Premiership. BBC ALBA shows delayed matches on Saturday evenings (Wikipedia). No live Premiership matches free-to-air.
